# Shillinq

> Business administration suite for Nextcloud, for freelancers, sole proprietors, SMBs and corporations: integrated financial, procurement and contract management. Requires OpenRegister, which stores its records.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): setup, build, test and lint commands, OpenSpec flow and conventions
- [README.md](README.md): overview, installation and the Docker evaluation stack
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): branches, pull requests and commit format

## Documentation

- [docs/intro.md](docs/intro.md): documentation home
- [docs/installation.md](docs/installation.md): installation
- [docs/Features/](docs/Features/): one page per feature
- [docs/guides/](docs/guides/): task guides (invoices, bank statements, bills)
- [docs/Technical/architecture.md](docs/Technical/architecture.md): architecture
- [docs/architecture/integration-points.md](docs/architecture/integration-points.md): integration points shaped but not implemented yet
- [docs/standards/](docs/standards/): accounting standards and output formats
- [docs/user-guide/](docs/user-guide/): user guide

## API

- [openapi.json](openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.0 description of the app's JSON API
- [docs/api/](docs/api/): notes on individual API surfaces

## Specifications and decisions

- [openspec/config.yaml](openspec/config.yaml): OpenSpec project context and rules
- [openspec/specs/](openspec/specs/): current requirements, one directory per capability
- [openspec/changes/](openspec/changes/): proposed and in-progress changes; finished ones in `archive/`
- [openspec/architecture/](openspec/architecture/): architecture decision records

## Code

- [appinfo/info.xml](appinfo/info.xml): app metadata
- [lib/](lib/): PHP backend
- [src/](src/): Vue frontend; pages in [src/manifest.json](src/manifest.json) and [src/manifest.d/](src/manifest.d/)
- [lib/Settings/shillinq_register.json](lib/Settings/shillinq_register.json): OpenRegister register and schemas
